forecast_contract: Fixed-origin multi-horizon scenario conditional on supplied x; no held-out y updates.

initialization.formula: Four independent canonical starts; global means [0,-1,-1,-1.5] plus independent Normal(0,0.25*prior_sd), prior_sd=[.5,.5,1,.5]; z_alpha,z_beta independent Normal(0,.25); h=-1+stationary AR1 perturbation with data rho and innovation_sd=.25*exp(-1.5), independent of start globals. Uses shape and fixed rho only; never observed values, generated truth or held-out data.
